title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating (Trainee) Los Angeles, CA
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life's uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers' evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert -you'll live into Allstate's Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
The Investigator - you'll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
The Effective Communicator - you'll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You'll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
The Negotiator - You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
The Problem Solver -you'll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
The Recorder - you'll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You'll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
Experience providing customer service face-to-face. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to ensure exceptional customer interactions.
Ability to travel to customers' homes and efficiently manage claims.
Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications:

Residency in/near Los Angeles, CA is mandatory for this role.
Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

You're provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:   

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:  

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:  

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you'll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

title: Associate Cybersecurity Advisor - Denver Metro
description:
CO Salary Range: USD 76,000.00 - 95,000.00 per year

The Associate Cybersecurity Advisor, a.k.a. Associate Portfolio Security Advisor (SA) plays a critical role in serving as a trusted partner to Optiv's clients. By combining sales skills,  business and broad industry knowledge, the Associate SA aligns the clients' security initiatives towards a highly defensible and scalable security program. The Associate SA has practical knowledge and provides our clients and sellers with consistent security expertise on all sales opportunities. In partnership with domain specialist and experts, the Associate SA will facilitate thought leadership and inspired cyber security solutions powered by our ecosystem of people, products, and partners.

How you'll make an impact

Drive the generation services and technologies business to meet or exceed quarterly and annual quota objectives in partnership with the account and domain teams. Follows the Optiv Standardize Sales Operating Processes (SOPs) to achieve consistent success.
Learn the client's security environment, business operations, security needs, and risk appetite. Identify a their security concerns and how they correlate to Optiv's strategic solutions across the assigned domain and holistic cyber security programs.
Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities across clients and Optiv's partner relationships.
Articulate how the necessary elements of the Optiv technology and services portfolio meet the specific needs of the client stakeholders at a management level. 
Collaborate with service delivery to ensure the team has necessary supporting domain specialty materials that presents a consistent and comprehensive approach.   
Effectively work with multiple client personas across the security team, as well as other relevant personas to develop security strategy and define roadmaps to execute on security strategy aligned business goals, budgetary spend, and metrics based on return of investment.
Build relationships at clients by participating in thought leadership, support, information, and guidance in conjunction with sales partners.
Build working relationships with targeted Optiv technology partners, based on client spend, and Optiv focus.  
Identify and drive security solutions to meet client objectives across technology and services including:facilitating new discussions by leveraging peer and industry network contacts
performing requirements gathering analysis, and technology selection criteria
coordinating demonstrations and security technology evaluations

Interface and partner with the internal Optiv teams, particularly service delivery liaisons, to align client expectations with the entire Optiv solution portfolio to ensure service delivery excellence and client satisfaction. 
Listen for client feedback and continually share with internal teams to evaluate and cultivate continuous improvement.
Participate in account planning, forecasting, and pipeline management activities. 
Participate in managing and prioritizing the proposal process to create business proposals, contracts, and respond to RFI/RFP's 
Actively pursue personal development by maintaining and obtaining technical capabilities, soft skills, and security specific knowledge through formal education, certification, and other avenues. 
Proficient sales techniques; makes connections, facilitates meetings, reads the room, asks probing questions, overcomes objections, gains trust, maintains composure under pressure, positions solutions, and assist in finalization of sale.

What we are looking for

Minimum of three (3) years in an information security or other IT related role.
Highly motivated self-starter that does not require day-to-day management. 
Ability to work in a highly adaptable and nimble team environment with responsive communication. 
Understanding of common security threats, vulnerabilities, and attack methodologies and able to communicate recommendations to clients in a clear manner.
Strong business and technical acumen and ability to lead technology focused discussions.
Strong presentation, written, and oral communication skills to clients, including whiteboard sessions and other presentation mechanisms. 
Strong attention to detail for reviewing statements of work (SOWs), quotes, and client deliverables. 
Builds a foundation of broad security related knowledge and continuously expands their expertise in other domains across the portfolio.
Perform additional duties as directed or needed.

title: Trading Specialist- Greater Detroit, MI Area (REMOTE)
location: Ann Arbor, MI, Farmington Hills, MI, Flexible / Remote, Grand Blanc, MI, Grand Rapids, MI, Novi, MI, Southfield, MI, Troy, MI
description:
Job Description:

NOTE: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position

To be eligible for consideration of this role, your primary residence must be located within a 90 mile radius at the time of application from the approved branch sites: Ann Arbor, Farmington, Grand Blanc, Grand Rapids, Novi and Troy.

The Role

As a Trading Specialist, you will support investors with a broad range of trading, investment, and account-related needs while helping deepen client relationships! This role involves guiding clients through market activity, processing complex securities transactions, and providing education that helps clients make informed financial decisions. By delivering personalized support through inbound client interactions, you will build trust, strengthen client loyalty, and find opportunities to connect clients with additional products and solutions. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of financial markets, trading products, industry regulations, and proficiency in breaking down complex concepts into significant client conversations.

The Expertise & Skills You Bring

Series 7 license required
Series 63 license or ability to obtain within 90 days
Experience in financial services, brokerage operations, trading support, client services, or a related field.
Knowledge of financial markets, investment products, economic trends, and industry developments.
Understanding of securities transactions, including equities, options, mutual funds, fixed income securities, and precious metals.
Ability to apply regulatory and policy requirements while delivering accurate and compliant support to clients.
Ability to guide clients through trading and investment decisions with integrity and confidence.
Consultative approach to uncovering client needs and recommending appropriate offerings, support, and solutions.
Excellent communication and active listening skills, including the ability to explain complex investment and trading concepts in a clear and relatable manner.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy when processing transactions and handling client requests.
Effective problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.
Ability to manage several priorities and perform effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

The Team

As part of Fidelity's Client Services organization, we serve as a key connection between our clients and a diverse selection of investment products, services, and financial solutions. Our team helps investors navigate the markets by providing trading support, education, and mentorship that builds confidence and trust. We are committed to delivering outstanding service, encouraging long-term relationships, and helping clients achieve their financial goals through every market environment.

Fidelity's Onsite Working Model
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

Certifications:

Series 07 - FINRA, Series 63 - FINRA

Category:

Customer Service
Please be advised that Fidelity's business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

title: Energy & Transmission Markets Analyst
description:
CO Salary Range: USD 87,100.00 - 157,450.00 per year

Description 
 
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

Leidos is a Fortune 500® company with $18 billion in sales and nearly 50,000 employees that brings over 70 years of experience in support of both investor-owned and municipal utility growth goals. Leidos Energy helps utilities address complex challenges through comprehensive, performance-based solutions delivered across the full project lifecycle. Our capabilities include engineering, planning, project management, construction management, and commissioning services for electric power substations, transmission and distribution systems, protection and controls design, and electrification programs. Utilities nationwide rely on Leidos for trusted power industry expertise, demonstrated by our work with more than 75 investor-owned utilities and over 100 municipal and cooperative utilities, as well as a growing portfolio of private developer clients.

Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos Energy is seeking an Energy & Transmission Market Consultant who is an experienced electricity market analyst to help expand an existing consulting practice focused on due diligence related to transmission congestion impacts under Security Constrained Economic Dispatch (SCED).

Work Location: Fully remote will be considered based on candidate experience and qualifications. Candidates within commuting distance of Denver, CO, or Framingham, MA is a plus.

What you'll be doing:

Perform complex electricity market modeling and transmission congestion analysis utilizing the PROMOD market simulation model with security constrained economic dispatch (SCED).
Analyze study results to develop study deliverables that provide meaningful and actionable solutions for clients.
Manage client engagements and ongoing client relationships.
Present study results and findings to client executives.
Research key energy market operational processes and current issues/trends.
Conduct business development activities both through internal collaboration and directly with clients and prospects.
Develop and expand key client relationships.
Support projects and project team members working both independently and in collaboration with other colleagues and managers.

What does Leidos need from me?

Bachelor's degree in engineering, Math, Science, Finance or related with four plus years of relevant experience.
Experience in energy markets with modeling software such as PROMOD IV, Encompass, UPLAN, or Plexos.
Experience in the electricity industry conducting economic studies of conventional and renewable generation.
Excellent quantitative and analytical skills, with proven ability to lead and communicate project results both verbally and in writing.
Strong knowledge and interest in power markets with understanding of basic transmission system operations and nodal (LMP) price formation.
Proven ability to effectively communicate with both clients and staff.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo - because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 - and moving faster than anyone else dares.

title: Parts Service Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary
The Parts Service Specialist is a key member of the Spares & Repairs team to manage the Inquiry To Remittance (ITR) process, interpreting customer RFQ requirements, quoting, processing customer's POs and ensuring the timely delivery of the customer order. Specialist is a key member of the Spares & Repairs team to manage the Inquiry To Remittance (ITR) process, interpreting customer RFQ requirements, quoting, processing customer's POs and ensuring the timely delivery of the customer order.

Job Description

 Roles and Responsibilities 

As the Parts Services Specialist you will:
Work within the GE Power Conversion Parts & Repairs team to deliver quotes in response to customer queries
Work across the GE Power Conversion business segments
Own the day to day RFQ fulfillment process, receive and validate purchase orders, and pass them to the Order Fulfillment team
Receive and log Request for Quotations (RFQs) from customers.  Including specific attention to the support of Rapid Quote response
Identify the requested part, and provide quotations to customers using the standard Parts Book, pricing
Liaise with all stakeholders to ensure on time quote delivery, including Material Management, Sourcing, Parts Definition team
Maintenance of all information of quotes in the quote tool (SFDC) to ensure accurate financial forecasting
Raise workflows to create and update parts
Resolve customer issues
Receive and check Purchase Orders
Accurately transfer process customer's Purchase Orders, for Order fulfillment.
Work with GE internal customers, warehouses, Fleet managers and Field Engineers, to support customer requirements and issues.
Act as lead fulfillment operational liaison for your required orders with GE sites, Sourcing, Planning and logistics service providers to support your customer order.
Ensure that all transactions are completed within ERP system and support invoice processing/collections as needed by the managing team.
Ensure that the business complies with local guidelines and laws, and GE policy

 Qualifications/Requirements :
Bachelor's Degree in Business or related field from an accredited university or college (OR a High School Diploma / GED with a minimum of 2 years of experience)
Minimum 2 years in a customer-oriented or quote management role

 Desired Characteristics: 
Intermediate/Advanced user of Microsoft Office
Experience in SAP / SFDC to build and manage quotes and support finance & data reporting
Customer focused in the provision of service
Ability to work in a matrixed environment
Ability to work under own initiative, with an understanding of appropriate escalation
Ability to work under pressure, and prioritize work appropriately
Ability to learn new tools and processes, and help improve on them
Effective written and oral communication skills
Detail and numbers oriented, with an organized approach to data reporting and record keeping
Punctual and reliable
Team player, able to be part of a team, and contribute to team work
Flexible attitude and approach to working hours

title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Rochester, NY
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life's uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers' evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

 The Customer Service Expert -you'll live into Allstate's Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

 The Investigator - you'll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

 The Effective Communicator - you'll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You'll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

 The Negotiator - You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

 The Problem Solver -you'll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

 The Recorder - you'll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You'll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

 Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

 Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

 Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

 Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

 Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

 This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

 Residency within 50 miles of Rochester, NY area is mandatory for this role.

 Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

 Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

You're provided with comprehensive training:

 The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

 Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating GA
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life's uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers' evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!  GA

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert -you'll live into Allstate's Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
The Investigator - you'll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
The Effective Communicator - you'll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You'll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
The Negotiator - You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
The Problem Solver -you'll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
The Recorder - you'll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You'll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

You're provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.
Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

Job Description

A day in the life of an Inside Property Contents Adjuster: New York or New Jersey

You will be handling contents claims virtually.
Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents.
Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.
You will be using advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.
Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.
Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.
Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.
Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert -you'll live into Allstate's Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Effective Communicator - you'll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. The Negotiator - You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
The Problem Solver -you'll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
The Recorder - you'll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You'll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Residency within New York or New Jersey.

Bachelors Degree.

title: Community Operations Specialist (Lead Generation) - TikTok LIVE
description:
Responsibilities

 The TikTok LIVE SMB service team is affiliated with the TikTok LIVE team. We aim to help TikTok's Small to Medium-Sized businesses (including merchants and creators) obtain more diverse customer acquisition and business operation methods through live streaming by building product capabilities and providing creator services, and to offer professional live streaming content for users.

About the role
The TikTok LIVE team builds and runs industry communities for creators across markets including the US, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and LATAM, helping creators grow customers and leads through live streaming. This role focus on driving the community into a full operating funnel, including making target merchants want to join, keeping them active once inside, converting inactivity into real actions like going live and adopting tools, driving live streaming and lead growth , as well as turning winners into contributors who bring in new members. 

Responsibilities
1. Acquisition: Build an acquisition mix across product entries, CRM outreach, offline events, and direct invites; design join hooks and a starter pack; and manage join rate and CAC by channel.
2. Engagement: Design and run a weekly content rhythm (industry news, live-streaming tips, case breakdowns, AMA / office hours, benefit days, showcases) and interaction mechanics (polls, check-ins, challenges, leaderboards, success-story sharing) that turn passive members into active, mutually supportive participants, with hands-on moderation.
3. Conversion: Convert engagement into real business actions (going live, adopting live / lead-capture tools, optimizing the live room) through a tiered "complete tasks to unlock benefits" growth and incentive system.
4. Webinars & education: Run tiered, invite-only webinars and a progressive education track that turns learning into a goal-oriented, resource-unlocking path.
5. Offline events: Organize meetups, regional networking, best-practice tours, and closed-door roundtables, so top merchants help the long tail grow, then bring that trust and those cases back into the online community.
6. Data & attribution: Build a funnel-based metric system (join, activity, first live, tool adoption, first lead through tiered lead growth) and use treatment-vs-control comparisons to prove the community's incremental contribution.
7. Advocacy: Stand up contributor roles (mentors, ambassadors, community champions), capture success stories and repeatable playbooks, and shift the community to a self-sustaining model.
8. Cross-functional collaboration: Work with product, data, and other teams to integrate product capabilities, campaigns, education, and support resources into one merchant journey.

Qualifications

 Minimun Qualification(s):
- Bachelor's degree or above, with 3+ years in community / user / growth / creator operations, including hands-on experience building a community from scratch or scaling one.
- Data-driven: able to build a metric system, read data to find problems, and validate operations with experiments and control groups, not just track group size.
- Strong content and program design skills: able to independently design and execute content cadence, interaction mechanics, challenges, webinars, and offline events.
- Strong cross-functional and project-driving skills, comfortable coordinating product, content, and data stakeholders in parallel.
- Working proficiency in English, able to collaborate directly with overseas teams, merchants, and creators.
- Genuine interest in live streaming, e-commerce, the creator economy, or local services, and willingness to stay close to frontline merchants and creators.

Preferred Qualification(s):
- Background in live streaming, the creator economy, or merchants and creator growth.
- Familiarity with operating overseas-market community platforms such as WhatsApp, Discord, Telegram, or Line.
- Experience running webinars, bootcamps, or large online / offline events.
- Experience building community automation (bots, FAQ knowledge bases).

Investigation: Assessing property damage, reviewing details, and determining coverage.

Maintain strong awareness of CLO market dynamics and communicate market color to internal and external stakeholders
Develop and maintain a point of view on issuer clients (pipeline, performance, and structural preferences)
Review, analyze, and negotiate CLO documentation and structural terms; identify, escalate, and resolve issues early
Negotiate stipulations with a comprehensive understanding of impacts to investors, managers, and rating agency modeling assumptions
Manage deal evolution while in-market; assess how changes to pricing, documentation, and terms affect structure and ensure updates are reflected in analysis and marketing materials
Partner closely with syndicate, analytics, and sales to deliver coordinated execution and high-quality client coverage
Lead client calls and clearly explain structural nuances and deal specifics (capital structure, documentation terms, collateral, key risks)
Take ownership on the marketing materials, ensuring quality control and consistency
Train, develop, and oversee junior team members; manage workflow and uphold analytical and execution standards
Contribute to business management, including monitoring desk performance and communicating priorities to senior management

Prior experience in CLO structuring/execution (BSL and/or private credit) or closely related structured credit role
Strong working knowledge of CLO documentation, transaction mechanics, and deal execution processes
Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex transactions and multiple parallel deadlines
Strong client-facing communication skills and relationship management capabilities
Strong quantitative and analytical skillset (advanced Excel required; Python/VBA a plus)
High attention to detail, sound judgment, and strong ownership mindset in a fast-moving environment

title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Rochester, NY
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life's uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers' evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

 The Customer Service Expert -you'll live into Allstate's Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

 The Investigator - you'll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

 The Effective Communicator - you'll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You'll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

 The Negotiator - You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

 The Problem Solver -you'll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

 The Recorder - you'll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You'll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

 Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

 Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

 Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

 Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

 Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

 This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

 Residency within 50 miles of Rochester, NY area is mandatory for this role.

 Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

 Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

You're provided with comprehensive training:

 The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

 Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

 You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

 As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

 If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

 As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employmen

title: Customer Proposals Specialist
description:
EBSCO Information Services (EBSCO) delivers a fully optimized research experience,  seamlessly integrated with a powerful discovery platform to support the information needs and maximize the research experience of our end-users.  Headquartered in Ipswich, MA, EBSCO employs more than 2,700 people worldwide, with most embracing hybrid or remote work models.  As an AI-enabled service leader,  we thrive on innovation, forward-thinking strategies, and the dedication of our exceptional team. At EBSCO,  we're driven to inspire, empower and support research. Our mission is to transform lives by  providing reliable and relevant information -  when, where and how people need it. We're seeking dynamic, creative individuals whose diverse perspectives will help us achieve this global, inclusive mission. Join us to help make an impact.

Your Opportunity

The Customer Proposals Specialist II develops accurate, compelling responses to RFPs, RFIs, and other procurement requests for EBSCO's FOLIO Library Services Platform and related SaaS solutions. This role combines professional library experience, knowledge of library systems and workflows, strong research and writing skills, and project management to translate complex customer requirements into clear, customer-focused proposal responses. The ideal candidate understands how libraries operate and can confidently evaluate technical and functional requirements from a librarian's perspective.

What You'll Do

Develop technically accurate, customer-focused responses to RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, proposals, clarifications, and other procurement documents for FOLIO and related EBSCO SaaS solutions
Analyze customer requirements to identify response needs, potential gaps, clarification questions, and areas requiring subject matter expert input
Research FOLIO capabilities, library workflows, integrations, implementation approaches, and related EBSCO solutions to develop complete and accurate proposal responses
Coordinate proposal projects from initial review through submission, including requirements analysis, assignments, timelines, stakeholder follow-up, document preparation, and final quality review
Collaborate with Sales, Product Management, Implementation, Technical Support, Information Security, Legal, and other subject matter experts to address complex functional and technical requirements
Translate technical product information and library systems concepts into clear, concise language focused on customer needs, workflows, and outcomes
Maintain reusable FOLIO and library systems content within the RFP response repository by adding new information and updating existing responses as products and capabilities evolve
Review proposal content for accuracy, consistency, completeness, compliance, grammar, and overall response quality

Your Team 

You will be welcomed as a member of the EBSCO RFP Team and will work closely with colleagues dedicated to proposals for FOLIO and related library technology solutions, as well as Sales, Product Management, Implementation, and technical subject matter experts across EBSCO. There will be ample resources, tools, training, and support to ensure your success as a Customer Proposals Specialist II and your development and career growth at EIS

About You

2+ years' experience working in a sales or comparable corporate environment with a proven record of successful communications and/or writing experience
2+ years of professional writing, research, project coordination, proposal development, or comparable experience requiring the interpretation and communication of detailed information
Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects or deadlines while coordinating information and deliverables across multiple stakeholders

What sets you apart

Master of Library Science, Master of Library and Information Science, or equivalent graduate library degree
Experience implementing or migrating to an integrated library system or library services platform
Experience as a systems librarian, technical services librarian, electronic resources librarian, implementation librarian, or in a comparable library technology role
Experience in responding to RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires, procurement documents, or other formal customer requirements

Pay Range

USD $60,240.00 - USD $86,060.00 /Yr.

 The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors including your skills, qualifications, education, training, and experience, as well as the position's work location.

Our Work Policy: We value the balance of remote focus and in-person connection. For all our roles not designated as onsite, candidates living within a 30-mile radius of one of our hub office locations (Ipswich, MA; Birmingham, AL; Contoocook, NH) are required to be on-site one day designated by their team for collaboration and syncs. If you reside outside of this 30-mile range, the position is considered fully remote.

EBSCO provides a generous benefits program including: 

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance and Flexible spending accounts 
-Retirement Savings Plan
-Paid Parental Leave 
-Holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) 
-Mentoring program 
And much more! Check it out here: https://www.ebsco.com/about/benefits

title: Project Manager, High Voltage Services
location: Atlanta, GA, Flexible / Remote, Houston, TX, Jackson, MS
description:
The Opportunity

As a Technical Project Manager, you will own customer projects and orders for HV Service from the Sales handoff through execution, customer validation, invoicing, and payment confirmation. You will verify order information and documentation, coordinate field service resources, manage project schedules, and communicate directly with customers and internal teams. You will plan and manage large Gas Insulated Switchgear substation installation projects, including equipment delivery, civil readiness, erection, gas handling, testing, commissioning, energization, and turnover. You will also support commercial activities, resolve customer disputes, monitor accounts receivable, and apply AI-augmented project management tools to scheduling, risk identification, resource forecasting, documentation, reporting, and project progress data.

How You'll Make an Impact

Own customer projects and orders from Sales handoff through execution, customer validation, invoicing, and payment confirmation.
Verify customer information, order documentation, contractual scope, and project requirements with the technical sales team.
Maintain service sales order documentation in SAP and verify field service dates and job information in FSM and the Field Handoff Order Sheet.

title: Vocational Project Coordinator - Resource Center Shopette
description:
WellPower envisions a community where every person’s mental health is fostered through strength, resilience and hope. We empower people to overcome barriers and achieve lasting well-being through collaborative behavioral health care and comprehensive support. 

Our Guiding Principles:

Person Centered. We honor people’s identities, lived experience and journeys and treat every person with the dignity we all deserve.  

Exceptional Care. We offer compassionate, innovative services that meet people where they are, from immediate support to long-term recovery.

Integrity. We operate from a deep foundation of ethical, accountable practices in all we do.

Organizational Resilience. We meet the moment and adapt to changing contexts with collaborative creativity, agile business processes, and financial stewardship.

Position Summary: 

​​Vocational Project Coordinators administer, monitor, and report out on assigned special project within the Rehabilitative Services Department. They are responsible for day-to-day operations of WellPower’s rehabilitative program, as well as overseeing employees performing job tasks under this program.​ 

 

Team Specific Information:

The Resource Center Shopette provides essential clothing, hygiene, household, and other items to community members. This role supports daily Shopette and Vocational Training operations by coordinating staffing and trainee coverage; scheduling shifts; managing inventory, eligibility verification, check-in/out, and data entry; and engaging with people served. 

Compensation & Benefits:

$30.12/hr - $31.25 ($62,650/yr - $65,000/yr)

For complete overview of our robust Benefits: https://wellpower.org/workplace-of-choice/ 

The posted range represents the full hiring range. Offers will not exceed this range, the majority of candidates are placed near the midpoint based on experience and qualifications. 

Job Duties & Functions: 

​Develop workflow, channels of communication, and procedures for the program. 

​Assist with the financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting needs of the team. Ensure compliance of established budget. 

​Complete comprehensive vocational assessments, utilizing aptitude, interest and other assessment tools. 

​Coordinate with other rehabilitative services, staff, and support, as well as with primary treatment clinicians. 

​Coordinate care between the rehabilitation department and the clinical teams. 

​Develop individualized training plans for clients in the vocational/rehabilitation program. 

​Coordination of client’s activities at assigned workstations/sites at WellPower. 

​Monitor client progress and activities with clients, documenting services provided. 

​Complete timely and accurate data, reports and clinical documentation as required. 

​Participate in pre-vocational partial care services. 

​Conduct rehabilitative and goal-oriented educational opportunities. 

​Plan and facilitate social activities within the community and with the program. 

​Promote the philosophy of recovery, wellness, and community integration through a strengths based, person-centered approach. 

​Supervise, coach, and support peer specialists, mentors, and vocational trainees. 

​Participate in hiring processes, on-boarding, and performance management, including disciplinary procedures when necessary. 

​Develop and maintain community/vendor relationships. 

​Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record. 

​Other duties as assigned

Requirements & Qualifications:

​​​Education: 

​Bachelor’s degree with minimum of three years of vocational experience or 

​Masters in related field 

​Experience: 

​​​Minimum three years of experience working with severe and persistent mental illness​. 

​Credentials/Certification: 

​​​​Certified Psychiatrics Rehabilitation Practitioner preferred.  

​Must have a valid driver’s license.​​​ 

Work Location: This is an on site position at WellPowers Resource Center - 1075 Galapago St, Denver

Shift/Hours: Monday - Friday 7am - 3pm

Physical Requirements: 

Requires sitting, standing, bending and reaching. May require lifting up to 50 pounds. Requires manual dexterity sufficient to operate standard office machines such as computers, fax machines, the telephone and other office and/or clinical equipment. 

Must wear steel toed boots while in designated areas of the Resource Center. May be required to drive fleet vehicles to pick-up donations/purchased product.

 

 

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

Learn more about WellPower:

 

WellPower is committed to fair and equitable hiring with salaries based on relevant factors, such as work experience, education, and certification/licensure (rather than wage history). Toward the principle of equal pay for equal work, we post and hire within defined hiring salary ranges. We ask all applicants to carefully review the hiring salary range for each posted job opportunity, as we will not hire outside the predetermined range. 

WellPower is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, transfer, or promotion opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. 

For a complete overview of our robust benefits, visit: https://wellpower.org/workplace-of-choice

title: Project Manager- Pharmacy Associate
description:

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Atlanta, Georgia. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

Responsibilities:
  Organize and support daily activities based on the goals of the program
 Identify optimization opportunities to support program objectives

 Lead certain components of the program
 Partner with other departments and various stakeholders to ensure operational excellence

 Support the tracking and monitoring of controls

  Bachelor's degree or 4 years commensurate experience.
 3+ years working for a PBM, Payer, or Pharmacy Consulting firm, with a focus on reviewing healthcare data.

 1+ years working with technical teams, integrations or product management.
  
Bonus points:
  Experience with medical payer and PBM claims adjudication systems, such as RxClaim.
 Experience with pharmacy claim testing and Quality Assurance (QA).
 Experience with a ticketing system (such as Jira or Appian).
 Experience with Project Management systems (such as Monday.com ).

title: Business Analysis Advisor - Mortgage Investor Operations
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company's success. As a Business Analysis Advisor, you will be within PNC's Retail Bank Operations organization, supporting the Retail Lending Servicing and Mortgage Investor Operations group.  This position is remote.

The scope of Retail Bank Operations is impressively broad and encompasses a wide range of critical functions. These include managing the cash needs for our branch and ATM networks, printing and mailing important bank documents, and handling both inbound and outbound collections for home lending, automobile, and card services. Additionally, Retail Bank Operations focuses on loan mitigation and investor operations, developing process improvement and automation opportunities, overseeing the daily processing of cash and check deposits, bill payments, and executes strategic quality management functions.

The Retail Lending Servicing, Mortgage Investor Operations team supports mortgage servicing investor operations across Freddie Mac, Fannie Mae, Ginnie Mae, private investor portfolios, and default cash, driving process improvement, operational effectiveness, reporting, controls, and business analysis initiatives. Successful candidates will bring experience in mortgage servicing, investor reporting, loan administration, business analysis, finance, accounting, or reconciliations, along with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and deliver reporting that supports strategic decision-making. Knowledge of the mortgage servicing lifecycle, including payment processing, escrow, loss mitigation, servicing transfers, MSP, default servicing, and investor reporting, is strongly preferred. This role requires collaboration across business, technology, risk, compliance, and operations partners to deliver solutions and drive continuous improvement.  In addition to the job description below, the ideal candidate will also have:  

Freddie Mac Servicing and Default Cash Postings:

Ideal candidates will have experience supporting Freddie Mac mortgage servicing operations, including investor reporting, investor accounting, loan administration, servicing transfers, remittance processes, reconciliation activities, and the interpretation and application of Freddie Mac servicing requirements. Candidates should also have experience processing and reconciling investor funds, mortgage insurance claim proceeds, liquidation proceeds, recoveries, refunds, and other default-related cash activity. Experience researching and resolving discrepancies, identifying process improvement opportunities, conducting root cause analysis, and partnering with cross-functional operational teams to strengthen controls, improve efficiency, and enhance servicing performance is highly valued.

Fannie Mae/Ginne Mae Servicing :

Ideal candidates will possess knowledge of Fannie Mae & Ginnie Mae servicing practices and investor guidelines, including reporting, reconciliation, compliance monitoring, servicing oversight, and operational support activities. Candidates should also have experience driving process improvement initiatives, identifying operational efficiencies, enhancing controls, and implementing sustainable solutions.   Successful candidates will be comfortable analyzing complex servicing requirements, translating business needs into actionable solutions, and partnering across multiple stakeholder groups. 

Private Investor & Portfolio Servicing:

Ideal candidates will have experience supporting private investor and portfolio servicing operations, including investor reporting, investor accounting, loan administration, servicing transfers, remittance processes, reconciliation activities, and the interpretation and application of investor-specific servicing requirements. Candidates should also have experience reviewing, interpreting, and operationalizing private investor servicing agreements and related contractual requirements, ensuring servicing activities, reporting obligations, remittance practices, and control processes align with investor expectations and contractual commitments. Experience supporting investor-related financial and operational processes, researching and resolving discrepancies, identifying process improvement opportunities, conducting root cause analysis, strengthening operational controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to improve efficiency, consistency, compliance, and servicing performance is highly valued.

This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC. If approved, work must be conducted from a quiet, secure, and confidential home-based workspace. Occasional in-office participation may be required based on business needs.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description
Directs the research, discovery, collection and interpretation of business requirements. Participates in the development and review of complex processes and procedures, workflow analytics and reporting. May provide senior level consultation and communicates with clients and technology teams on business designs, problem solving and business analysis to support project goals and objectives.
Consults and recommends the frameworks, methodologies and processes involved in business requirements traceability for business analysis teams. Independently mentors, leads, and coaches other associates to affect knowledge transfer. Oversees the development and maintenance of all applicable policy and procedure documentation.
Translates business needs, processes and/or procedures by partnering with applicable experts and business stakeholders

title: Project Manager
description:
Who We Are

KeepTruckin builds technology using the latest advancements in AI and computer vision to improve the safety and efficiency of businesses with vehicles. Over one million drivers and 100,000 companies across every industry trust KeepTruckin’s integrated platform to power their operations, prevent accidents and reduce costs.  

At KeepTruckin, we see our hard work rewarded in tangible ways every day, and we believe that intelligence is most powerful when paired with humility. We’re motivated by the opportunity to save lives on the road while impacting and improving every facet of multiple trillion-dollar industries that keep our physical economy moving. KeepTruckin is proud to be a Forbes Cloud 100 company, Forbes Best Startup Employer 2020, and an Inc Magazine Best Place to Work.

About the Role:

As a Professional Services Project Manager, you will play a lead role in managing highly impactful projects for some of our highest value customers. You will be interacting with, both, internal and external stakeholders on a frequent basis and owning the projects from the development of the project plan through delivery. The ideal candidate would create and manage project plans, communicate project status and timelines with internal and external stakeholders, and determine project profitability. You will be an expert on the KeepTruckin products and will have the ability to guide the customers on the best utilization of our system and a smooth initial setup.

What You'll Do:

Define and maintain the scope of the projects for clients based on KeepTruckin and customer definitions of success

Lead project kick-off and conduct regular scrum meetings until the successful delivery of the project

Effectively communicate the project status to all stakeholders

Operating as the primary point of contact during the assigned clients onboarding phase

What We're Looking For:

3+ years experience in a customer-facing role in a B2B capacity

Strong business background including project management, account management, problem-solving, business planning, and analytical skills

Prior experience managing multiple projects in a corporate setup

Excellent interpersonal, communication (both written and verbal), and presentation skills

Experience in delivering client-focused solutions based on customer needs

Ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels and in situations requiring instructing, persuading, negotiating, conflict resolution, consulting and advising, as well as flawless written communication

Ability to provide leadership and influence others

Software development lifecycle experience preferred

PMP certification or the equivalent preferred

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of KeepTruckin's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. 

Please do not let an arrest or conviction record prevent you from applying for employment at KT. KT considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

title: Commissioning Specialist
description:
Job Description Summary

Reporting to the Commissioning Manager, the Commissioning Specialist is responsible for performing the tests under GE GSI scope of work determined by the Commissioning Manager / Coordinator for the specific project according with safety, quality, and technical requirements. Working with the Commissioning Lead and Commissioning Coordinator, the Commissioning Specialist will be executing the commissioning plan with the on-site supervision of the Commissioning Lead or equivalent, performing the tests, ensuring the products and equipment reach an acceptable result as per the documentation, troubleshooting when necessary, and submitting the test reports as soon as they are finished to the team for review. It's also a responsibility of the Commissioning Specialist to provide feedback about the tests and processes to improve them and/or to correct potential gaps.

Job Description

About Us:

Come bring your energy to change the world Grid Solutions, part of the GE Vernova portfolio of energy businesses, serves customers globally with over 12,000 employees. Grid Solutions provides equipment, systems, and services to bring power reliably and efficiently from the point of generation to end power consumers. We electrify the world with advanced grid technologies and accelerate the energy transition.

GE Vernova, a dynamic accelerator comprised of our Power, Renewable Energy, Digital and Energy Financial Services businesses, is focused on leading a new era of energy - electrifying the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. If you are ready to make a difference and usher in a new era of energy, come join us.

Why we come to work:

At GE Vernova, we are always up for the challenge - and we're always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you'll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you'll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the green energy transition

Essential Responsibilities:

Preparation and planning phase:
Support the project execution team on commissioning matters.
Technical governance and customer relations on commissioning matters.
Plan and support pre-commissioning effort (instrumentation, documentation, etc.).

Execution phase:

Ensure work is performed safely according with GE standards and local requirements.
Contribute to overall quality and excellence in execution of commissioning.
Perform instrument functionality verification at site.
Responsible for the start-up of the various auxiliaries' system.
Conduct electrical commissioning tests on instrumentation.
Conduct commissioning tests (electrical and mechanical) of auxiliaries' systems of Substation plants and synchronous condenser facilities.
Perform the electrical test support for the start-up of Substation plants and synchronous condenser facilities.
Perform LOTO and safety preparations as required for the commissioning tests.
Provide support to the site teams regarding the technical issues or challenges.
Keep good records about site activities, work performed, issues faced and how they were dealt with (non-conformity) to provide feedback to business and support it with information in case of claims.
Collaborate in resolving complex problems.

Mandatory Qualifications / Requirements:

Strong EHS culture.
Be available for work on project sites in Canada and US.
Good understanding of electro-mechanical systems.
Ability to multitask and shift between many different projects and initiatives with tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal skills, teamwork skills and autonomy.
Ability to build strong customer relationships.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with minimum supervision.
Strong customer service orientation.
Ability to navigate cross-functions and create a good rapport with other teams (Project Management, Engineering, Finance, Fleet Support, EHS, HR, etc.).
Ability to comply with mandatory requests on time, such as: trainings, timesheets, expense reports, daily reports, etc.
Understand and implement, when required, cost and schedule control for commissioning scope.
Must be proficient in French and English.

Technical:

Technical skills in programming and testing of PLC's and Controls
Testing of power distribution and delivery equipment of Low/medium Voltage Switchgear, disconnect switch, circuit breaker, capacitor bank, reactor, and Transformers.
Testing of power distribution and delivery equipment of High Voltage Switchgear, Switchgear, disconnect switch, circuit breaker, capacitor bank, reactor, and Transformers.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.) and have good computer skills.

Desired Characteristics:

Proficiency in any data acquisition software considered an asset.

Electrical or mechanical installation experience considered an asset.

The salary range for this position is 78,800.00 - 105,000.00 - 131,200.00 USD Annual . The specific salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including the candidate's experience, their education, and the work location. In addition, this position is eligible for a performance bonus.

Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach, a 24/7 nurse-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Retirement Savings Plan, a tax-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness.

title: Project Manager - Major Correctives-2
description:
Job Description Summary
This role is responsible for the safe, compliant, and profitable execution of Major Component Upgrade (MCU) and Blade projects across North America.

The Project Manager independently leads assigned projects from planning through closeout, maintaining accountability for safety, quality, schedule, cost, customer satisfaction, and contractual compliance. The role serves as the primary liaison between customers, field execution teams, subcontractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

Successful candidates demonstrate strong leadership, sound business judgment, and the ability to make operational decisions in dynamic field environments.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

Safety, Quality & Compliance

Champion a strong safety culture and lead by example.
Accountable for project EHS performance and corrective action closure.
Ensure compliance with GE Vernova safety standards, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
Maintain prevailing wage compliance and support certified payroll accuracy.
Ensure project documentation remains audit-ready throughout execution.
Own quality documentation, inspection records, punch list management, and final customer acceptance.
Lead lessons learned and continuous improvement activities following project completion.

Project Execution & Leadership

Own end-to-end execution of assigned MCU and Blade projects.
Develop detailed execution plans aligned with customer requirements and operational constraints.
Lead project kickoff meetings and establish clear expectations with field teams and stakeholders.
Monitor project progress and proactively manage risks, issues, and recovery plans.
Drive execution excellence through daily, weekly, and milestone-based project reviews.
Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to quality standards.

Financial Management

Develop and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost controls.
Monitor labor, equipment, crane, subcontractor, travel, and material costs.
Identify financial risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Manage project invoicing support, change orders, and cost recovery opportunities.
Maintain accountability for project profitability and forecast accuracy.

Customer Relationship Management

Serve as the primary customer-facing representative for assigned projects.
Lead customer status meetings and provide routine execution updates.
Manage customer expectations and facilitate timely resolution of concerns.

 Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure and their security practices
